role: Lead Systems Architect & Full-Stack Engineer (BukSU CMS-V2)
task_description: Audited student dashboard space bloat and layout inefficiency: (1) Removed false 'Adviser confirmation pending final submission' requirement from TeamsPage lock checklist; (2) Merged fragmented dual-tier invite elements on TeamsPage into a unified Invite Teammates card; (3) Renamed BulkInviteModal to Invite Teammates, removed 'Paste Multiple Emails' tab, scoped default candidate view to unassigned section peers with global search fallback; (4) Eliminated ghost mock data leak (SAMPLE_EVENTS) in DefenseScheduleCalendar and DashboardPage; (5) Implemented dual-mode Agenda Timeline / Month Grid view in DefenseScheduleCalendar with accessible button day cells; (6) Redesigned student dashboard Phase 0 experience into a high-density Capstone Onboarding Stepper (Steps 1-4) with clear CTAs, eliminating redundant 0-metrics and empty boxes; (7) Normalized all text-secondary colors to canonical text-muted-foreground design tokens. Verified with 22/22 targeted client tests, Playwright visual audits across desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports in light and dark modes, UNMATCHED_COUNT=0 route parity, and 60/60 agentic validation checks.
lessons_learned: Lesson: Never return undefined from empty array memo hooks when downstream components declare default parameters with fallback sample mock data (calendarEvents returned undefined instead of [], triggering SAMPLE_EVENTS default with fake Team Alpha HealthAI hearing).

Lesson: Student dashboards in academic systems should differentiate Phase 0 (unassigned onboarding) from active project execution; displaying empty 0% / 0 approved metrics creates cognitive dissonance, whereas a sequential onboarding journey provides actionable direction.
Lesson: Segmented Agenda vs Month view toggle compresses calendar space from 550px to 140px while delivering richer contextual information for infrequent academic milestones.
